title: TurboQuant Pro weight plan
description: The record emitted by `tqp plan weights` (turboquant_pro.weight_plan.WeightPlan). It is the exact minimum-damage choice of one bit width per matrix under a stored-bit budget, solved as a multiple-choice knapsack by dynamic programming on the gcd lattice, plus the Lagrangian dual bound computed independently of that solve. tqp.weight_plan/1.

solver.const: exact multiple-choice knapsack (DP on the gcd lattice)
solver.description: The solve is exact or the plan is not written; an instance above --max-states is refused, never approximated.

tool_version.description: turboquant-pro package version that produced the plan.

request.description: The budget the plan was solved against. Exactly one of `bytes` and `bits_per_weight` is set; the other is null.

costs.description: Path to the tqp.weight_cost_table/1 document that was read.

bytes.description: Stored-size budget in bytes, or null when --bits-per-weight was given.

bits_per_weight.description: Budget as code bits per weight, or null when --bytes was given.

model.description: Copied from the cost table the plan was solved against.

predictor.description: Copied from the cost table; the damage model, e.g. a measured KL or a diagonal Fisher.

cost_table_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical cost table, so the plan cannot be applied with costs from a different model or predictor.

budget_bits.description: The stored-bit budget the solve was given.

stored_bits.description: Stored size of the chosen plan; never above `budget_bits`.

cost.description: Total damage of the chosen plan: the exact minimum under the budget.

dual_bound.description: Lower bound on the optimum from the Lagrangian dual, computed independently of the dynamic program.

duality_gap.description: cost - dual_bound. Never negative for a correct solve, apart from a rounding artefact at the scale of the costs.

lattice_unit_bits.description: Greatest common divisor of every candidate stored size; the lattice the dynamic program runs on.

lattice_states.description: Points on that lattice within the budget, i.e. the width of the dynamic program.

matrices.description: How many matrices the plan assigns a bit width to (a count here, the name->shape map in the cost table).

bits.description: Matrix name -> the bit width chosen for it. One entry per matrix in the cost table.
